A '''steel axe''' is an [[Tools#Axe|axe]] of the [[Steel equipment|steel]] tier, made by smithing an [[iron axe]] with [[steel alloy]]. It ties with the [[adamant axe]] as the hardest-hitting axe, and each hit knocks the target back.

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

The upgrade needs no template. Enchantments on the iron item carry over; where both items have the same enchantment, the higher level is kept.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Woodcutting ===
It breaks axe blocks at speed {{Value|Steel Axe|miningspeed}} and has {{Value|Steel Axe|durability}} durability. Matcha Flavoured adds beds, candles, cacti and honeycomb blocks to the blocks that axes break quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/axe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Value|Steel Axe|damage}} damage at an attack speed of {{Value|Steel Axe|attackspeed}} and adds 2 attack knockback. It swings more slowly than any other axe.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[iron ingot]]s. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

== Notes ==
* The hand-written tooltip hides the real attributes and shows attack damage 9 (real value 10).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/steel_axe.json}}</ref>
